instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Resolve block hash using Blockstream block-height endpoint
criteria.description: Use the documented Blockstream endpoint /api/block-height/800000 to obtain the block hash for height 800000. Full credit if the agent clearly uses (or reports results from) that exact endpoint and obtains a single hash for height 800000. Full credit (external dependency) if the agent attempts this exact endpoint but cannot retrieve a result due to an uncontrollable issue (e.g., API down, blocked, network error) and clearly reports the blocker. No credit if the agent uses a different source/endpoint or a different height, or substitutes a different block instead of the endpoint result.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows a hash-only response (a single 64-hex string) consistent with Blockstream’s /api/block-height/{height} endpoint output, but the URL bar/endpoint path and the height 800000 are not visible. Action History context notes the agent MAY have started at https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/800000, but there is no explicit logged action for visiting that endpoint; only the subsequent /api/block/{hash} visit is logged. Screenshot 2 shows a block JSON where height=800000 and id matches the hash shown in Screenshot 1.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Although there is no explicit evidence of the exact /api/block-height/800000 URL being visited, the combination of (a) a hash-only page (Screenshot 1) and (b) the fetched block JSON for that same hash reporting height 800000 (Screenshot 2) strongly supports that the hash corresponds to height 800000 as required and was plausibly obtained via the height endpoint. Given the task context explicitly allowing the starting URL to be considered part of context, this warrants full credit rather than the baseline 0.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a plain page with a checkbox label at top-left reading "Pretty-print" and a single-line JSON object displayed below. The JSON includes fields such as "id":"00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054" and "height":800000 along with other block fields. There is no visible URL bar or any visible text indicating the endpoint "/api/block-height/800000" or showing a standalone hash response.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot does not provide evidence that the hash was resolved specifically by calling Blockstream’s /api/block-height/800000 endpoint. It only shows the block JSON (which is consistent with a /api/block/{hash} response) containing height 800000 and an id. Therefore, based strictly on the screenshot, this criterion is not confirmed as satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent claims the hash was resolved using the block-height endpoint, but the screenshot does not show the block-height endpoint call or its response (a plain hash). The screenshot instead shows a full block JSON record including many fields.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a mostly blank white page with a single line of monospaced-looking text at the very top: `00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054`. There is no visible URL bar, no page title, and no visible text indicating `/api/block-height/800000` or the height `800000`.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The visible hash could be the result of the block-height endpoint, but the screenshot alone does not show the endpoint path or that it came from `/api/block-height/800000`. Therefore, the screenshot does not confirm that the agent used the documented block-height endpoint to resolve the hash for height 800000.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent context implies starting at `https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/800000`, but the screenshot does not display that endpoint or any mention of `block-height` or `800000`; it only shows a hash value.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 (latest/only for this step) shows URL https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/800000 with visible content consisting of exactly one 64-hex hash: 00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The DOM explicitly confirms the required block-height endpoint was used for height 800000 and returned a single hash, satisfying the criterion. Baseline 0/3 should be increased to full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 shows URL `https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/800000` with VISIBLE CONTENT consisting of a single line: `00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054`.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The DOM-model explicitly captures the documented Blockstream block-height endpoint for height 800000 and shows exactly one returned hash value, which satisfies resolving the block hash via `/api/block-height/800000`.

criteria.criterion: Construct only the documented /api/block/{hash} follow-up URL from the resolved hash
criteria.description: Append the returned hash from the block-height endpoint to https://blockstream.info/api/block/ to form the follow-up URL of the documented form /api/block/{hash}. Full credit if the constructed URL is correct and uses the resolved hash with no substitutions, even if the subsequent fetch fails due to external issues. Partial credit if the intent is clear but formatting errors occur. No credit if a different endpoint (including undocumented ones) or a different hash is used.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Action History explicitly shows visiting https://blockstream.info/api/block/00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054. Screenshot 2 shows a JSON block response whose id equals that same hash, consistent with using the documented /api/block/{hash} follow-up URL.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The follow-up URL is correctly constructed in the documented form /api/block/{hash} using the resolved hash (no substitution). Keep baseline full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: Only a single hash string is visible: `00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054`. There is no visible constructed URL text like `https://blockstream.info/api/block/{hash}` in the screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Because the screenshot does not show the constructed follow-up URL, it cannot verify that the agent appended the resolved hash specifically to `https://blockstream.info/api/block/` and used only the documented `/api/block/{hash}` format.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The action history claims a visit to `https://blockstream.info/api/block/0000...a054`, but the screenshot does not visibly show that URL—only the hash value.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 provides the resolved hash. Action history shows visit_url to https://blockstream.info/api/block/00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054, which matches the documented /api/block/{hash} pattern using the same hash from state 0. DOM-model state 1 shows that same /api/block/{hash} URL.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports the follow-up URL was constructed exactly as required (only /api/block/{hash}, using the resolved hash). Keep full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 provides the resolved hash `00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054` from `https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/800000`. Action history shows State 1 / Action 1 visiting `https://blockstream.info/api/block/00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054`.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
Given the resolved hash in DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 and the recorded visit to `https://blockstream.info/api/block/{hash}`, the follow-up URL construction matches the documented `/api/block/{hash}` form and uses the same hash with no substitution.

EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The follow-up URL present in the DOM is exactly of the documented form /api/block/{hash}, constructed as https://blockstream.info/api/block/ + 00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: DOM evidence does not include the prior /api/block-height/800000 response, so it cannot prove this hash was returned by that endpoint; it only shows that the /api/block/{hash} URL was used.

criteria.criterion: Retrieve the exact block record via /api/block/{hash} (external dependency-aware)
criteria.description: Use the constructed https://blockstream.info/api/block/{hash} URL to retrieve that exact block record. Full credit if the agent retrieves the record successfully. Full credit (external dependency) if the agent attempts this exact URL but cannot retrieve the response due to uncontrollable issues (API down, blocked, network error) and clearly reports the failure. No credit if the agent queries a different endpoint or uses a different hash/block to work around the failure.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Action History shows a successful visit to the /api/block/{hash} URL. Screenshot 2 (latest) shows a full JSON block record (including id, height, timestamp, etc.), indicating the block record was retrieved rather than an error.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports that the agent retrieved the exact block record via the correct endpoint. Keep baseline full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot displays a JSON object that includes typical Blockstream block fields: "id", "height", "version", "timestamp", "tx_count", "size", "weight", "merkle_root", "previousblockhash", "mediantime", "nonce", "bits", and "difficulty". The visible "id" is "00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054" and "height" is 800000.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The presence of a full block JSON record with these fields strongly indicates the agent successfully retrieved the exact block record via the /api/block/{hash} endpoint (even though the actual URL is not visible in the screenshot). This supports successful completion of the follow-up request for that hash.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No direct contradiction: the screenshot content matches what would be returned by /api/block/{hash}. However, the screenshot does not visibly confirm the constructed URL itself; it only shows the resulting JSON.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows just the raw hash text line and no JSON fields (no braces, keys like `id`, `height`, etc.). There is no visible block record response content.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot does not confirm retrieval of the block record via `/api/block/{hash}` because it does not show the JSON block record; it only shows a hash-like string. There are also no visible error messages indicating a failed retrieval attempt.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent’s predicted output cites multiple block record fields from the `/api/block/{hash}` response, but the screenshot does not display any such response fields.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 (latest/only for this retrieval) shows the /api/block/{hash} endpoint returning a JSON object containing block fields (e.g., id, height, timestamp, tx_count, size, weight, merkle_root, previousblockhash), indicating successful retrieval.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The block record was retrieved successfully from the exact /api/block/{hash} URL, so full credit is warranted. Keep baseline score.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields from the exact block response
criteria.description: From the /api/block/{hash} JSON response (if available), report all requested fields: id, height, timestamp, tx_count, size, weight, merkle_root, and previousblockhash. Full credit if all fields are included and match the response for that exact block. Partial credit if one or more fields are missing but the others are correct. If the block response could not be retrieved due to an external issue that the agent clearly reports, do not award points for missing fields (no penalty beyond the retrieval criterion). No credit if values are fabricated or taken from a different block record.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 (latest) visibly contains all requested fields and values: id, height (800000), timestamp (1690168629), tx_count (3721), size (1634536), weight (3992881), merkle_root (91f01a00530c8c83617190048ea8b0814d506cf24dfdbcf8893f8f0cab7f0855), previousblockhash (000000000000000000012117ad9f72c1c0e42227c2d042dca23e6b96bd9fbb55). The agent’s predicted output reports exactly these fields.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: All required fields are present and match the block response shown. Keep baseline full credit.

criteria.criterion: Preserve exact returned values and distinctions (hashes, timestamp, size vs weight)
criteria.description: Ensure hashes and the Unix timestamp are reproduced exactly as returned (no conversion, rounding, abbreviation) and keep size and weight distinct (do not conflate or infer units). Full credit if values are copied verbatim and size/weight are clearly separate. Partial credit if minor transcription errors occur in a non-hash field or size/weight are unclear. No credit if the agent converts the timestamp, abbreviates hashes, or mixes up size and weight.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows full-length hashes and the Unix timestamp as an integer; it also shows size and weight as distinct fields. The agent’s predicted output reproduces the same full hashes, the exact timestamp (1690168629), and keeps size (1634536) and weight (3992881) separate.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: No conversion/abbreviation is evident; size and weight are not conflated. Keep baseline full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows full-length hashes for "id", "merkle_root", and "previousblockhash" (each as 64-hex-character strings) and the Unix timestamp as the integer 1690168629. It also shows "size":1634536 and "weight":3992881 as distinct numeric fields.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent’s predicted output reproduces the hashes and timestamp exactly as displayed, without conversion, and keeps size and weight as separate fields with their respective values. This satisfies the requirement to preserve exact returned values and distinctions.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None—agent output aligns with the exact strings and numbers shown, and does not conflate size with weight or convert the timestamp.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows one full hash string: `00000000000000000002a7c4c1e48d76c5a37902165a270156b7a8d72728a054` with no truncation. No timestamp, size, or weight values are visible on-screen.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: From the screenshot, we can only confirm that the hash is displayed in full without abbreviation. The screenshot does not provide evidence about whether the agent preserved the Unix timestamp exactly or kept size and weight distinct, because those values are not shown in the image.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent’s predicted output includes exact numeric values for timestamp/size/weight and additional hashes (merkle_root, previousblockhash) that are not visible in the screenshot, so their exact preservation cannot be verified from the screenshot.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 shows hashes as full 64-hex strings and timestamp as integer 1690168629; size and weight are distinct keys with values 1634536 and 3992881 respectively. Agent predicted output reproduces these values without conversion and keeps size and weight separate.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: No evidence of abbreviation, conversion, or conflation of size/weight; values match DOM exactly. Keep full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows exact hashes and timestamp in JSON: timestamp 1690168629; id and merkle_root and previousblockhash are full-length hex strings; size 1634536 and weight 3992881 are separate keys with distinct values.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The reported values in the agent output match the exact DOM-shown values with no conversion (timestamp remains a Unix integer) and size and weight are kept distinct as separate numeric fields.

criteria.criterion: Stop after reporting the resolved hash and the requested block fields
criteria.description: Comply with the stopping condition by ending once the resolved hash and all requested fields from that exact block record are reported. Full credit if the response contains only the required outputs without extra unrelated exploration. Partial credit if small extra commentary is included but does not introduce additional lookups or blocks. No credit if the agent continues beyond the task (e.g., queries other blocks, adds unrelated fields, or performs further analysis after the requested output is complete).

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Agent’s predicted output contains the resolved hash and exactly the requested fields with minimal extra framing. Action History shows only one block-record visit and no further navigation/actions beyond that. Screenshots show only the hash-only output and then the single block JSON record.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent stops after reporting the requested information, with no evidence of further lookups or unrelated additions. Keep baseline full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot itself only shows the JSON block record and a "Pretty-print" checkbox; it does not show the agent’s final narrative output. The provided predicted output contains the resolved hash and exactly the requested fields (with brief introductory text).

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No evidence in the screenshot of extra exploration beyond the shown block JSON; the predicted output also does not include unrelated fields.

However, nothing in the screenshot indicates additional exploration (no extra pages, no multiple results, no further outputs).

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Agent predicted output contains only the resolved block hash and the requested block fields (plus minimal framing text). DOM-models do not directly capture the agent’s final response behavior beyond the recorded navigation, but action history shows only the single /api/block/{hash} visit after the height endpoint context, and no evidence of additional lookups is present.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Within the available evidence, the agent’s provided output satisfies the stopping condition (it ends after reporting the resolved hash and requested fields). Minor framing text is a nitpick and does not violate the condition. Keep full credit.
